sanskrit_verse: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परिग्रहे स्वजात्या श्रेयसी भार्या स्वजात्यश्च पतिः स्त्रियाः
transliteration: brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parigrahe svajātyā śreyasī bhāryā svajātyaś ca patiḥ striyāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: In the union of Brahmana, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra, the wife most conducive to dharma and prosperity is she who is of the same jati; likewise, the husband of a woman must be of her own jati.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation arises from harmonious varna-jati alignment
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by innate spiritual-cultural resonance
Restoration logic operates through re-establishing dharmic relational symmetry
Consciousness alignment is optimized when jati-integrity is preserved in unions
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudication must prioritize jati-congruent relational structures where constitutional dharma is upheld through consciousness-aligned unions. Responsibility thresholds are determined by the capacity to sustain dharma, not by punitive measures. Legal recognition of marriage must reflect svajāti alignment as foundational to societal harmony.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that svajāti alignment ensures minimal karmic friction and maximal dharmic flow. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfoldment of relational integrity when jati-resonance is honored. Responsibility is proportional to consciousness-capacity, not social judgment. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that misaligned unions self-degrade unless realigned through conscious completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reintegrate jati-integrity through svadharma restoration workshops
Establish svayambhu dharma-commitment framework for ongoing alignment
final_declaration: This ruling emanates solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma is restored through svajāti alignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
